content: Ngyeel a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl
Ungö apan, mpal kyàkwe ilä a Pantɛkɔt, alɔŋki banswà bàkàköŋ ikal imwɛy.
Yàmɛnà naa kà imbürà, làso làfü du: la làkäl asànaa un'pöb a ngwal akayaa anà akayöölà ndwà yanswà bàkälà ba.
Taaŋ nsil alan, yàmɛnà anà ndem mwɛy asànaa ndem a mbaa. Ya yakyer akaabà, waa yàbwee udu a umwɛy umwɛy uboo a ba.
Apan sye Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàwɛl ba banswà, ba waa bàsɛmà mutɛn unsà ndaa asin yà ifà ifà, mbuur mbuur asànaa Dweelà kàswɛŋà nde ba mutɛn.
Kyekà taaŋ nsil alan, Ayudà a mpem aŋàbwaŋ bàfü in'sɛŋ myanswà amyu mɛɛn, bàkäl u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mpal bàwem ba làso alan, un'sɛŋ wanswà kàyi u ntiin. Ba bàkäl mubem, ntɔn mbuur mbuur kàweemà u ndaa ande ŋakwo bàtɛɛnà ba.
Ba bàkäl unsà lingyoomà anà ubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Làler, baar bàyäämà bà banswà, nkye ba kà baar a Ngalilɛ anki?
Iswaŋà aben naa bi ikaweemà umwɛy umwɛy u ndaa a bul ande ŋakwo?
Uboo abi, bi ibà anà bà Partɛs, bà Mɛdɛs, bà Ɛlamit, bi ifàkal u Mɛzɔpɔtami, u Yuday, u Kapadɔs, u Pɔn anà kà itiir a nsi a Azi,
u Frizi bàfàbel sye Pamfili, u Ngipiti, u Libi tsütsü a Sirɛn, u Lɔmà,
u Krɛt anà Arabi. Bi ibà Ayudà unsà mböör abi anà Ayudà unsà inzaam, wɛɛ mbuur mbuur uboo a bi wàmuweemà u ndaa ande ŋakwo indiir a kölàköl kan'kyer Nzam. »
Ba banswà bàkäl unsà lingyoomà anà isak isak. Ba bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: « Abà iswaŋà aben? »
Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàsɛɛ aŋàlàkwikilà, waa bàtɛn naa: « Ba bàŋàyɔr ubwaŋàbwaŋ! »
An'lɔɔŋ a Petɔlà
Apan, Petɔlà waa kàmbarà anà Bàkwen Aŋimwɛy, nde kàtɛn u ndaa a ngwal a baar mbɔɔn naa: « Abaal a Yuday anà bɛ banswà làfàkal u Yɛlusàlɛm, làwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa amɛ!
Aay, baar bà kàbàŋàyɔr anki asànaa làkasii bɛ, ntɔn bi ibà u taaŋ làwà làtutu.
Wɛɛ papà, ndaa kàkyään ŋangɔɔm Ywel yan'kwo:

content.text: "Làler ndaa isàlyaaŋ kà ilä a ntsüü,
mɛ in'sàtsuul Dweelà amɛ udu a mbuur wanswà,
baan abɛ babaal anà bakaar bàsàtà ngɔɔm,
mɛ in'sàtɛn kà imanmii akà baan ambɛy abɛ
anà u ndwɛy akà anün abɛ.
Ɛɛ, mɛ in'sàtsuul Dweelà amɛ itàkal udu a asyääl amɛ babaal anà bakaar kà ilä abin,
mɛ in'sàtsuul Dweelà amɛ, ba bàsàtà ngɔɔm.
Mɛ in'sàmɛɛy indiir a ubem untaal u du
anà idiim ungyɛl udu a mɛɛn: an'kil, mbaa anà un'swey a un'diŋ a mbaa,
taaŋ làsàbulà mpib,
nsöŋ asàbulà wàtsöö asànaa an'kil
kusà a ilä a Mwol muyà, ilä a kölàköl anà kyàlàkoo.
Abun, mbuur wanswà asàbel ikɔb a Mwol asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈."
Baar a Isàlɛl, làwem ndaa yi: Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr wà mbuur kàtöm Nzam ntɔn bɛ. Nde kàkyer isal a ngwal, indiir a ubem anà idiim uboo a bɛ asànaa làyöb bɛ ŋakwo,
mbuur awà bàkyer un'yälà kà an'kɔɔ a baar abɛ asànaa kàbön Nzam itaan unsà an'kyän ande. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkyer un'dwa, lun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi u kɔɔ a baar abɛ.
Wɛɛ Nzam kun'fuur u mɔ̈ɔ̈, kun'tsuuŋ unsà usaay a nkweel, ntɔn yàlàkwo anki naa an'lɔŋ mun'käär uboo a ikɔ̈b a ma.
Lalan David kàtɛn nde ntɔn nde naa:
"Mɛ kàmɛnà Mwol taaŋ lanswà kusà a mɛ,
ntɔn nde wà u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal ntɔn mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà.
Ntɔn ndaa ayi, mpem amɛ yà unsà un'sak anà mun amɛ wàmutwey ndaa a ntsà. Abun, ndür amɛ sye isàbɔ̈ɔ̈n unsà làkyän.
Ntɔn ngye, ngye mɛ asan'wɛy anki kà an'lɔŋ. Ngye asun'wɛy anki mbuur angye wàŋin'kyɛɛl upɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Ntɔn ngye mɛ kan'swɛŋ mbwo a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà ngye asan'yööl a un'sak u mii a ngye."

content: Atɔŋ, wɛy mɛ alàkyään alää naa undweer David kàkyàkwà ndandaa, bàkyun'dyee. An'dii ande mà tsütsü apà bi tii ŋàbawà.
Wɛɛ nde kàkäl ŋangɔɔm anà kàkyer ayöbà naa Nzam kàdi kyän naa: "Mɛ in'sàsà ikyee angye u kir a imwol angye".
David kàyöb kusà ndaa iyàyà ntɔn ngwiiyà a Klistɔ, nde kàtɛɛnà naa Nzam asun'wɛy anki kà an'lɔŋ, nde sye usàwɛy anki ndür ande ipɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Yɛsu awà, Nzam kàkyun'wiiy, bi banswà ibà ambäl.
Abun, Nzam kun'sɛɛn, waa kun'si u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, nde kan'wal akà Taa Dweelà Inkyɛɛl kàbön nde, waa kàmun'tyaaŋ. Ayin ya làmanà anà làweemà bɛ yi.
Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, David kàbeenà anki du nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ nde kàtɛn naa:

content.text: "Mwol kàtɛn a Mwol amɛ naa:
Yabwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal,
tii mpal in'sàsà mɛ aŋankir angye u ngyɛl a in'kɔl angye."
Wɛy un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl wanswà uyöb ndandaa naa Yɛsu akwà bɛ, lun'bɛɛrà bɛ u kulunsi, Nzam kàkyun'sà Mwol anà Klistɔ. »

content: Ndaa ayi yàpɛ mpay mbɔɔm akà baar bàwem ya. Ba bàfuul Petɔlà anà antööm bumwɛy naa: « Atɔŋ abaal, ininà bi kan'kwo mukyer? »
Petɔlà waa kafuur abà: « Làbuul mpem abɛ, wɛy mbuur mbuur uwɛl ndüümà kà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ, ntɔn bàladwääl nkul a man'be abɛ. Apan bɛ làsàwal kab a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Ntɔn ilää kyà bɛ, ntɔn ikyee abɛ anà ntɔn in'sɛŋ a nsi a kwɛlàkwɛl usàbel Mwol Nzam abi tsütsü apà nde. »
Wɛɛ unsà ndaa yà ifà ifà, nde kàkweenà naa ba bàkyey ndaa kàtɛɛnà nde anà kalɔɔŋà nde naa: « Làkaabà a nkööl a lingyoomà yi. »
Abun baar bàkyey ndaa a Petɔlà bàwɛl ndüümà. Ilä akin baar bàbilà uboo a un'tüüb a aŋàlàkwikilà bàkäl kà isii a nsaab tär.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ a un'tüüb
Wɛɛ ba bàsi muküünà mulab an'lɔɔŋ a Antööm, mukal un'tüüb ba banswà: ba bàkäbà, bàdyee anà bàyayamà ikal imwɛy.
Mbuur wanswà kàkäl u bɔɔmà, ntɔn Antööm bàkyerà impà anà idiim mbɔɔn.
Aŋàlàkwikilà banswà bàkälà ikal imwɛy, indiir aba byàkäl byà ba banswà.
Ba bàyälà mɛɛn anà indiir aba anà mukab bweel ba banswà mbuur mbuur u ngyal ande.
Unsà ukwen aba, ilä byanswà ba bàfabweyà u ndwà a Nzam. Unsà un'sak wanswà anà ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr u mpem, ba bàfadyaa ibööl u ndwà aba.
Ba bàfasyaŋà Nzam, baar banswà bakyer akweenà. Ilä byanswà Mwol kàkwɛyà kà Ikööŋ aba baar kàtswää nde mɔ̈ɔ̈.
